create_gl_renderer: create a glRenderer instance with custom width, height, and shader program files for 3D rendering
set_mesh_data: set mesh vertices and faces with optional color data for rendering 3D models
add_mesh_incremental: add additional mesh data to existing rendered mesh by concatenating vertices and faces
configure_camera_view: configure camera view mode with orthogonal or perspective projection using setCameraView and setCameraViewOrth
render_and_capture: render the scene and capture screen color or depth values using get_screen_color_fbgra or get_z_value
